lemmas.lemma: kle seg i sekk og aske
lemmas.primary_translation: (originally a Jewish custom) show outward signs of grief, repentance

word_forms.word_form: kle seg i sekk og aske

definitions.text: (opprinnelig en jødisk skikk) vise ytre tegn på sorg eller anger
definitions.translation: (originally a Jewish custom) show outward signs of grief, repentance (lit. clothe oneself in sackcloth and ashes)
